title: hyvv accepts rizzstack.brief/1, maps unversioned briefs, and records validation on the attempt

outcome.summary: hyvv vendors the standard-library rizzstack.brief/1 validator that B3 lands (validators/python/rizzstack_validators.py) together with the frozen schemas/rizzstack-brief.schema.json and schemas/rizzstack-attempt.schema.json, and uses them at POST /v1/attempts. A brief that names schema rizzstack.brief/1 is validated and the attempt record gains brief_validation {status, problems, unknown_fields}. A brief without a schema key keeps working exactly as before: it is recorded as unversioned with the field names the launcher consumed. Report-only: no refusal path is added in this slice.
observable_behavior: A brief with schema rizzstack.brief/1 carrying all seven required fields is accepted and the attempt record carries brief_validation.status == valid with empty problems and unknown_fields.
A v1 brief missing `risk` is still accepted (report-only) and records brief_validation.status == invalid with a problem whose path names risk.
A v1 brief carrying a key the frozen schema does not declare is accepted and lists that key in brief_validation.unknown_fields.
An unversioned brief (no schema key) is accepted exactly as before and records brief_validation.status == unversioned with legacy_fields listing the keys the launcher consumed.
The vendored validator runs under `python3 -I -S` with no installed jsonschema, and the vendored schema files are byte-identical to the frozen workflow originals (sha256 pinned in the approved test).
The launcher's existing refusal set is unchanged: a missing objective or a bad assigned_files list behaves as it does today.

The closed public attempt schema (contract/v1/schemas/attempt.json) declares brief_validation as object|null, so the required /v1 conformance suite accepts the additive field; the slice adds this declaration and nothing else to the public contract.

interfaces.name: POST /v1/attempts
interfaces.notes: Additive: the 200/201 body's attempt record gains brief_validation. No new refusal.

interfaces.name: launcher.brief_validation
interfaces.notes: Pure: (brief) -> {status, problems, unknown_fields, legacy_fields}; calls the vendored validator with the vendored schema_dir. No network, no crypto.

interfaces.name: schemas/rizzstack-brief.schema.json
interfaces.notes: Verbatim frozen B2 schema from workflow main, sha256 pinned by the approved test.

interfaces.name: schemas/rizzstack-attempt.schema.json
interfaces.notes: Verbatim frozen B2 schema from workflow main, sha256 pinned by the approved test.

interfaces.name: contract/v1/schemas/attempt.json
interfaces.notes: Add a brief_validation property (object|null) to the closed public attempt schema, so the additive field the attempt record now carries satisfies the required /v1 conformance suite (test_attempt_listing_matches_schema and the create/list cases). No required key and no other property changes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: a rizzstack.brief/1 brief with the seven required fields is accepted and recorded as valid with no problems and no unknown fields
a v1 brief missing risk is still accepted and records invalid with a problem naming risk (report-only: no refusal path)
a v1 brief carrying an undeclared key is accepted and lists that key in unknown_fields
an unversioned brief is accepted exactly as before and records unversioned plus the field names the launcher consumed
the vendored validator imports under python3 -I -S and the vendored schema files hash identically to the frozen workflow originals
the launcher's existing refusal set is unchanged: a brief without objective is still refused with 400
the public attempt schema declares brief_validation as object|null and stays a closed object
